description: List recent impersonation coins, newest first, filtered by brand, chain, time and severity. Use to answer "are there fake <brand> tokens?", to monitor a brand, or to collect cases for a takedown. Free tier returns alerts older than 24 h only (max 20).

brand.description: Brand id, name, or ticker, e.g. "spacex", "SpaceX", "TSLA". See list_brands.

chain.description: Optional chain filter (bsc = BNB Chain, robinhood = Robinhood Chain). Omit for all chains.

include_watch.description: Also include watch-tier brand mentions (memes), not just impersonation alerts.

limit.description: Max alerts to return (Free tier capped at 20). Narrow with since/brand instead of paging.

min_risk.description: Only alerts with risk score >= this (needs an API key; ignored on the keyless Free tier).

since.description: Start time: relative ("24h", "7d", "30m"), ISO 8601 ("2026-10-01") or unix seconds.

name: search_alerts
title: Search impersonation alerts
